{{Quote|Two days later, he disappears. The day after, a piece of him is located in Gevis City, the next day one in Verdson, the next &hellip; well you get the idea.|[[Helkson Vall]], to [[Intel Agent 438432]]|<ref name="WIAN" />}}
'''Verdson''' was a location. During the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the Imperial [[Sub-Prefect]] [[Matagorn]] was [[Death/Legends|murdered]] by the [[Srrors'tok]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Tyionsis Cex]], and a piece of Matagorn's body was subsequently found in Verdson.
